items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: because I worked with the trumpet player name, we used to call him Cuckoo. Yeah, Talbert.

ctx.x: I couldn't work every day, and I couldn't work. Yeah, so I think he went back and got Alton Poinnell on, and went with him.

Yeah. I mean, now if I had, I'd been able to go along with him, I mean I would have been up there all along with him, and George Marrero, because I worked with the trumpet player name, we used to call him Cuckoo. Yeah, Talbert.
